description: A random team generator — paste a list of names and split it into fair teams. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

count.description: The number of teams, or the people per team, depending on mode. Names are dealt round-robin after a shuffle, so team sizes never differ by more than one.

mode.description: What count means. "teams": make that many teams. "size": make teams of that many people, with the last team taking the remainder rather than anyone being left out.

names.description: The people to deal out, one name per line. Lines are trimmed and blank lines are dropped, so a pasted spreadsheet column works as it is.

name: random_team_generator
title: Random Team Generator
